title: Conditional-description encoding
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, take the unary product of the encoding of the pair consisting of the true-bit positions in its second decoded component and the word obtained by applying the halting-word transformation to its first decoded component.
caveat: The precise meanings of unary product, pairing, and the halting-word transformation are not supplied.
